title: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
slides: Is bad news for Jensen Huang bad for AI?
Nvidia's stock dropped after earnings call
The bottleneck isn't chips anymore — it's power
Your AI projects will hit energy limits first
Check your power budget before scaling GPUs
thread_text:
1. Nvidia's Bad News Is Not the AI Story

Nvidia stock dropped after earnings, but the real constraint on AI isn't chip supply—it's electricity. The market may be looking at the wrong bottleneck.

2. The Bottleneck Shifted

For years, AI progress was gated by GPU availability. Now, power infrastructure is the limiting factor. Data centers are struggling to secure enough energy to run the hardware they already have.

3. Your AI Projects Will Hit the Wall

Energy constraints won't just affect hyperscalers—they'll hit your projects too. Before scaling, you need to know your power budget, not just your compute budget. Otherwise, you'll stall.

4. Power Budget First

Before you plan your next GPU cluster, check your power allocation. If you can't power it, you can't scale it. The energy ceiling is real, and it's closer than you think.

5. Action: Audit Your Power Today

Check your current power usage and future needs. Can your infrastructure support the GPUs you're planning to add? If not, address it before you buy more hardware.
